workingTitle: Diablo 4’s Most Nostalgic Season Is Becoming (Mostly) Permanent

secondary.title: Diablo 4 Season 16's new endgame upgrades just got a whole lot more juicy
Blizzard is making a lot of the Diablo 4's event-specific Diablo 2 anniversary content permanent because everyone loved it in Season 15
Fan-favorite Diablo 2 anniversary bosses and items won't disappear when Diablo 4's next season starts

unreadable.title: Diablo 4’s Most Nostalgic Season Is Becoming (Mostly) Permanent

facts.context: Blizzard details the updates being made to Diablo 4 Season 16 following the 3.3.0 PTR, including much more valuable endgame customization.
Blizzard has heard the community's "overwhelming requests" to bring back the anniversary festivities of Season 15, which include some of the most satisfying secret quests the series has seen.

singleSourced.context: It'll all culminate in the return of the Corrupted Reaper, but this time she's brought along a friend, the Fractured Reaper, with the two of them "working together synergistically" and combining their abilities in a fight that promises to put us to the ultimate test.

singleSourced.key: works like a traditional lair boss
singleSourced.value: works like a traditional Lair Boss,
singleSourced.context: So is the prime Evil Council fight, which now "works like a traditional Lair Boss," with the only requirement being a Wirt's Lucky Coin if you want to open the rewards chest at the end.

singleSourced.key: to encourage choice and limit the impact of some of the most powerful effects
singleSourced.value: to encourage choice and limit the impact of some of the most powerful effects.
singleSourced.context: It's also split the new Horadric Legendary items, which come with extra set bonuses, into weapon and armor variants "to encourage choice and limit the impact of some of the most powerful effects."

singleSourced.key: we heard overwhelming requests for features from season of hell s legacy to carry forward as permanent game features
singleSourced.value: We heard overwhelming requests for features from Season of Hell's Legacy to carry forward as permanent game features,
singleSourced.context: "We heard overwhelming requests for features from Season of Hell's Legacy to carry forward as permanent game features," Blizzard wrote in Season 16's announcement post.

singleSourced.key: while the entire season couldn t come along for the ride we are implementing the following features with the launch of season of tyrael s gambit that will carry forward in both eternal and seasonal realms
singleSourced.value: While the entire season couldn't come along for the ride, we are implementing the following features with the launch of Season of Tyrael's Gambit that will carry forward in both Eternal and Seasonal realms.
singleSourced.context:
"While the entire season couldn't come along for the ride, we are implementing the following features with the launch of Season of Tyrael's Gambit that will carry forward in both Eternal and Seasonal realms."

Season of Tyrael's Gambit kicks off 1st December, so you still have time to access all of that in Diablo 4 until Season 15 ends.
